Record Class PlayerSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.it.observer.PlayerSnapshot
Record Components:
name - player nickname
totemColour - chosen totem colour
food - current food amount
prestigePoints - current prestige points
turnOrder - current turn-order position
tribeCharacters - acquired character cards
tribeBuildings - acquired building cards
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record PlayerSnapshot(String name, TotemColour totemColour, int food, int prestigePoints, int turnOrder, List<CardSnapshot> tribeCharacters, List<CardSnapshot> tribeBuildings) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable snapshot of a player's visible state at a specific moment.

Includes the player's full tribe (characters and buildings acquired so far) so that every view can render every player's tribe without polling the model.

Implements Serializable so it can be passed inside Message objects over RMI and via Java object serialisation over sockets.
